# Leave work others can rerun

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_pathways.py from data/pathways.yml. Do not edit this file: change the data and run the script. -->

Describe, record, and share work so that someone else can run it again.

**5 tutorials, 30 to 35 minutes in all.** Take them in order, or start wherever your question is. Nothing is locked.

New to the portal? Take [New to MESA](new-to-mesa.md) first.

!!! warning "These tutorials are drafts"
    Each tutorial says at the top how far it has been checked.

## Preserve and share

You can leave work that someone else can find, understand, and run again.

1. [Write a README for a data folder](../tutorials/write-a-readme.md) (10 minutes)
2. [Add metadata to a file or folder](../tutorials/add-metadata.md) (5 minutes)
3. [Record the software versions a result depends on](../tutorials/record-software-versions.md) (5 minutes)
4. [Leave a notebook someone else can rerun](../tutorials/leave-a-rerunnable-notebook.md) (5 to 10 minutes)

## Orient and navigate

*Work in MESA.* You can get into MESA, find data, run an app, and keep what you make.

1. [Share a folder with a collaborator](../tutorials/share-a-folder.md) (5 minutes)

More in this area:

- [Read the metadata on a folder shared with you](../tutorials/read-shared-metadata.md) (5 to 10 minutes)
- [Stop sharing a folder](../tutorials/stop-sharing-a-folder.md) (5 minutes)
